no_records: No records yet. Add one below.
record_hint: The record must already exist in the TransIP zone. This integration only keeps its content up to date.
record_incomplete: Fill in both a domain and a record name.

panel_disable_confirm: Turn the panel off? Settings move back to the options dialog.
